text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Ministry of Labour has written to the Maputo daily Noticias deploring an advertisement it carried from a Maputo shopping centre announcing two vacancies for female shop assistants -- "one of them white, preferably".

- Mozambican police say a man accused of the murder in April of British couple Andrew and Caroline MacGowan has admitted killing Caroline but not her husband. The couple were ambushed by car thieves on the road between Zimbabwe and Malawi that runs through northern Mozambique.
- Vendors at informal markets in Maputo are still selling caustic soda as a remedy for mouth ulcers despite a public health warning that such treatment can lead to serious injuries or even death.
